edges.text: Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod; pre=True becomes mode='before', each_item=True becomes validating the list items in the function, always=True becomes validate_default=True on the Field.
Move the check into an Annotated type with AfterValidator / BeforeValidator.
Import BaseSettings from pydantic_settings instead of pydantic and keep the class otherwise unchanged.
Import BaseSettings from pydantic_settings and replace the inner class Config with model_config = SettingsConfigDict(...), keeping env_prefix and other settings.

Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod; pre=True becomes mode='before', each_item=True becomes validating the list items in the function, always=True becomes validate_default=True on the Field.
Move the check into an Annotated type with AfterValidator / BeforeValidator.
Replace Model.__fields__ with Model.model_fields; field.required becomes field.is_required(), outer_type_ becomes annotation.
Replace .dict(...) with .model_dump(...), keeping the same keyword arguments.
Replace .dict() with dict(obj) and filter keys by hand.

Update `validate_namespaces` to return the literal `"*"` unchanged before iterating over `v` (and adjust its return type accordingly). Currently the wildcard is converted to `["*"]`, so cluster discovery may treat it as a namespace name instead of listing across all namespaces.

Replace the `_T is Optional` check in `__process_type` with handling based on `typing.get_origin(_T)` and `typing.get_args(_T)`: when the annotation is a `Union` containing `NoneType`, return `Optional[__process_type(the_non_none_type)]`. This preserves optional strategy-setting types when generating Typer options instead of silently converting them to `str`.

In `validate_resources`, return `"*"` unchanged before iterating over `v` (and keep the return type as `Union[list[str], Literal["*"]]`). Otherwise an explicit `--resource '*'` is treated as a sequence of characters and fails kind lookup.

In `__list_hpa_v1`, replace `async for hpa in res` with a normal `for hpa in res`: `_list_namespaced_or_global_objects` returns a list, not an async iterable, so the v1 HPA fallback raises a `TypeError`.
